setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A rare Crimson Comet is rumored to improve recovery, but taking it from its reef may threaten the remaining population.

choices.label: Capture the fish for a gravely ill patient.
Observe the fish in its habitat instead.
Ask whether a temporary, nonlethal study is possible.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The fish dies in captivity, and the patient remains ill.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The healer learns that the fish appears near healthy coral, suggesting another explanation.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The patient receives ordinary care while the fish remains undisturbed.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The study is abandoned when the fish shows signs of distress.

a1__fx.name: Outcome A1
a1__fx.text: The patient improves after the fish is brought near, though the cause is uncertain.
